parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'llama3.2:latest', _ultralab_task: 'chat', stream: false, format: 'json', options: { temperature: 0.1, num_ctx: 8192, num_predict: 800 }, keep_alive: '30m', prompt: 'You are an expert systematic review librarian. Generate optimized search queries for 3 academic databases based on this research question.

Research question: ' + ($json.body && $json.body.question || $json.question) + '
Inclusion/exclusion criteria: ' + (($json.body && $json.body.criteria || $json.criteria) || 'none specified') + '

Generate queries adapted to each database syntax:
1. PubMed: Use MeSH terms and PubMed boolean syntax (AND, OR, [MeSH Terms], [tiab]). Be thorough.
2. OpenAlex: Use natural language search terms, space-separated keywords.
3. Crossref: Use free-text keywords with the most important terms.

Return ONLY valid JSON with these keys: pubmed_query, openalex_query, crossref_query' }) }}

assignments.name: prefilter_count
assignments.value: ={{ (function(){var b=$('User Input').first().json.body;var d=$('User Input').first().json;var x=(b&&b.prefilter_count!==undefined)?b.prefilter_count:d.prefilter_count;var n=Number(x);return isNaN(n)?300:n;})() }}

assignments.name: max_results
assignments.value: ={{ (function(){var b=$('User Input').first().json.body;var d=$('User Input').first().json;var x=(b&&b.max_results!==undefined)?b.max_results:d.max_results;var n=Number(x);return isNaN(n)?1000:n;})() }}

conditions.leftValue: ={{ (function(){var b=$('User Input').first().json.body;var d=$('User Input').first().json;var x=(b&&b.custom_pubmed_query!==undefined)?b.custom_pubmed_query:d.custom_pubmed_query;return (typeof x==='string' && x.trim().length>0);})() }}
